scope: Offline static source and ARM9 inspection. No ROM edits, emulator, PC runtime, or save mutation.
thunk_decode_reproduction: For each pinned ROM, read bytes(NintendoDSRom.fromFile(path).arm9), assert arm9[0x6FDFC:0x6FE04] == bytes.fromhex('00 4b 18 47 05 fe 06 02'), then struct.unpack('<I', arm9[0x6FE00:0x6FE04])[0] == 0x0206FE05. The body begins at offset 0x6FE04, after the literal.

GetMonNature.entry_effect: At ARM9 offset 0x6FDFC, 0x4B00 loads r3 from PC+0; 0x4718 branches through r3. The aligned literal at ARM9 offset 0x6FE00 is bytes 05 FE 06 02, unpacked as little-endian u32 0x0206FE05. Clearing Thumb bit 0 gives body address 0x0206FE04; the literal ends at 0x6FE04, so it does not overlap the body.

GetBoxMonNature_body.behavior: Calls BoxMonSetFastModeOn, GetBoxMonData(field 0 / personality), BoxMonSetFastModeOff, then GetNatureFromPersonality.
GetBoxMonNature_body.interpretation: The current getter derives nature from PID; it does not read field 114.

GetNatureFromPersonality.behavior: Unsigned remainder by 25; source returns pid % 25.

GetBoxMonData.behavior: Outer BoxMon wrapper; generic field dispatch is at 0x0206E6A0. Field-114 case 0x0206EA58 loads the halfword at block B + 0x1A.

SetBoxMonData.behavior: Outer BoxMon wrapper; generic setter is at 0x0206EDE8. Field-114 case 0x0206F234 writes the complete halfword at block B + 0x1A.

CopyBoxPokemonToPokemon.behavior: Copies 0x88 bytes (17 paired word transfers) from the BoxPokemon object to the destination box payload; then changes party-only fields and calls CalcMonLevelAndStats at 0x0206E250.
CopyBoxPokemonToPokemon.limit: Static binary confirms the copy and call target; it does not prove a live PC round trip.

source_paths.stats: pokemon.c:370-386 calls GetMonNature for the five nature-adjusted stats; CopyBoxPokemonToPokemon calls CalcMonLevelAndStats after copying.
source_paths.trainer_memo: trainer_memo.c:333 calls GetMonNature for the summary memo nature line.
source_paths.pc_into_party: CopyBoxPokemonToPokemon performs the exact 0x88-byte copy before changing party-only fields and recalculating stats. Source: pokemon.c:3228-3245. The compiled ARM9 copy loop is byte-backed at 0x02071780-0x02071808.
source_paths.party_into_box: CopyPokemonToBoxPokemon assigns dest = src->box (pokemon.c:3284-3286); PCStorage placement copies the whole BoxPokemon value. RestoreBoxMonPP modifies only move PP (pokemon.c:4175-4186). This establishes source-level preservation of block B + 0x1A, but no target overlay disassembly or live PC test was made.
source_paths.linker_symbols: engine/upstream/hg-engine/rom.ld maps GetBoxMonData 0x0206E640, SetBoxMonData 0x0206ED70, GetMonNature 0x0206FDFC, and CopyBoxPokemonToPokemon 0x02071780. GetBoxMonNature is the thunk target/body at 0x0206FE04, matched by call flow and pinned source; it has no separate rom.ld symbol.

next_hook: If implementing effective nature, the narrow current getter hook is the GetBoxMonNature body at 0x0206FE04 (Thumb 0x0206FE05), preserving PID fallback when field-114 override is zero. Validate its callers and checksum/decryption behavior; stats and trainer memo use it, while PID-derived flavor/breeding paths may bypass it.
risks_and_limits: Binary-identical ARM9 regions establish the same getter/wrapper behavior in Alpha2 and c885, not in every overlay or future build.
Source-level PC copy assignments preserve all BoxPokemon bytes, but the PC storage overlay was not disassembled or tested in-game.
Changing GetBoxMonNature alone does not change consumers that derive nature directly from PID.
This does not establish global ownership of mask 0x003E, effective nature behavior, save persistence, or PC round-trip acceptance.
